25 class ProcessedData
26 {
27 /**************************** CONSTANTS *****************************/
28
29 public:
30 static constexpr float INVALID_VELOCITY = 1000.0f;
31 static constexpr float INVALID_RANGE = INVALID_VELOCITY;
32
33 /***************************** METHODS ******************************/
34
35 public:
36 ProcessedData() : radarsCount{RadarSystem::MAX_NUMBER_OF_RADARS},
37 lObjNumPoints{0U, 0U, 0U, 0U},
38 lObjVelocity{INVALID_VELOCITY, INVALID_VELOCITY, INVALID_VELOCITY, INVALID_VELOCITY},
39 lObjRange{INVALID_RANGE, INVALID_RANGE, INVALID_RANGE, INVALID_RANGE},
40 pObjPeak{0, 0, 0, 0},
41 pObjNumPoints{0U, 0U, 0U, 0U},
42 pObjVelocity{INVALID_VELOCITY, INVALID_VELOCITY, INVALID_VELOCITY, INVALID_VELOCITY},
43 pObjRange{INVALID_RANGE, INVALID_RANGE, INVALID_RANGE, INVALID_RANGE}
44 {
45 }
46
47 void processData(unsigned radarId, const ObjectInfoMsg &objectInfoMsg)
48 {
49 // Traverse through all objects of received message from radar with radarId
50 // Find object with the highest number of points and peak and take its points, velocity and range values
51 for (unsigned i = 0; i < objectInfoMsg.getPayloadItemsCount(); i++)
52 {
53 // Store number of points, velocity and range of the object with the highest number of points
54 if (objectInfoMsg[i].numPoints > this->lObjNumPoints[radarId])
55 {
56 this->lObjNumPoints[radarId] = objectInfoMsg[i].numPoints;
57 this->lObjVelocity[radarId] = objectInfoMsg[i].velocity;
58 this->lObjRange[radarId] = objectInfoMsg[i].range;
59 }
60
61 // Store number of points, peak, velocity and range of the object with the highest peak
62 if (objectInfoMsg[i].peak > this->pObjPeak[radarId])
63 {
64 this->pObjNumPoints[radarId] = objectInfoMsg[i].numPoints;
65 this->pObjVelocity[radarId] = objectInfoMsg[i].velocity;
66 this->pObjRange[radarId] = objectInfoMsg[i].range;
67 this->pObjPeak[radarId] = objectInfoMsg[i].peak;
68 }
69 }
70 }
71
75 void resetForNextEap()
76 {
77 for (unsigned i = 0; i < radarsCount; i++)
78 {
79 lObjNumPoints[i] = 0U;
80 lObjVelocity[i] = INVALID_VELOCITY;
81 lObjRange[i] = INVALID_RANGE;
82 pObjPeak[i] = 0;
83 pObjNumPoints[i] = 0U;
84 pObjVelocity[i] = INVALID_VELOCITY;
85 pObjRange[i] = INVALID_RANGE;
86 }
87 }
88
89 /************************ INSTANCE VARIABLES ************************/
90
91 public:
92 unsigned radarsCount;
93 unsigned lObjNumPoints[RadarSystem::MAX_NUMBER_OF_RADARS];
94 float lObjVelocity[RadarSystem::MAX_NUMBER_OF_RADARS];
95 float lObjRange[RadarSystem::MAX_NUMBER_OF_RADARS];
96 uint16_t pObjPeak[RadarSystem::MAX_NUMBER_OF_RADARS];
97 unsigned pObjNumPoints[RadarSystem::MAX_NUMBER_OF_RADARS];
98 float pObjVelocity[RadarSystem::MAX_NUMBER_OF_RADARS];
99 float pObjRange[RadarSystem::MAX_NUMBER_OF_RADARS];
100 };
